power_thermal_after_set_only.note: Only sampled after the set. Battery Saver became enabled at some point during or after this sequence; the transition time and per-trial status are unknown.

memory_after_set_only_kb.note: One post-set snapshot only; it does not establish absence of growth or a leak.

first_process_request.classification: First real trace in the new app process; model-load span present. OS/filesystem cache state is unknown.

repeated_requests_ids_2_through_13.model_load_span: Not observed in all 12 repeated rows; this is not a measured zero-duration load.
repeated_requests_ids_2_through_13.native_teardown_span: Not observed in all 12 repeated rows; this is not a measured zero-duration teardown.

prior_live_microphone_baseline_context_o.comparison: Distinct microphone takes and earlier capture/build/power state; descriptive context only, not matched PCM or a causal speedup estimate.

decision.observed: The signed app wrote and retained one request-load trace followed by twelve complete resident-reuse-marked traces. The app-side journal survives process restart and was retrieved by scoped adb pull.
not_established: Matched-PCM paired performance gain or transcript equivalence
Causal percentage improvement versus the earlier baseline
Model-switch, cancellation/drain/retry, shutdown, or real memory-pressure eviction behavior on device
Long-term retained-memory stability or leak freedom
Visible-render completion (endpoint is in-app result state publication)
decision.next_gate: Keep #1 and #5 open; the reuse markers make the implementation path observable, but remaining duration, lifecycle, memory-stability, and second-day checks are outstanding.
